entries.packages/compiler/src/cli/fsm-gen.mjs: the command line of the compiler (bin fsm-gen), which the gen targets of the root Makefile and the tests of make compiler-test run by path
the golden files of the npm kind, which gen-command.test.mjs of make compiler-test compares by path with the output of fsm-gen
entries.tests/npm-types/consumer.ts: the consumer file that tsc of make npm-types compiles against the generated declarations

packages/db.reason: fsm-db, the DbStore of fsm: an npm project with its own package.json and lock, which make db-test runs

entries.src/models/models.ts: the models that orm-gen generates (make fsm-db-gen, never tracked); MANIFEST_TEXT and MANIFEST_HASH are the documented API of a generated module of orm and stay exported by orm's design

ignoreDependencies.@polyspec/ordered-json: no JavaScript of the project imports it: the overrides of package.json pin it by "$@polyspec/ordered-json", which npm accepts only for a direct dependency, so that @polyspec/orm installs this release URL (npm 12 installs a URL dependency only when the root names it, --allow-remote=root)

packages/gui.reason: fsm-gui, the GUI of fsm: an npm project with its own package.json and lock, which make gui-build, gui-test and gui-browser-test run

entries.client/main.ts: the client entry of the GUI, which hyper-build-assets of make gui-build bundles

packages/js.reason: the npm consumer test bed of fsm: an npm project with its own package.json and lock, which make fsm-js-test, npm-types and npm-persist-test run

entries.src/*.d.ts: the generated declarations of the npm kind, which tsc of make npm-types compiles tests/npm-types/consumer.ts against

binaries.go: packages/compiler/tests/go-backend.test.mjs (make compiler-test) runs go vet on the generated Go package, and tests/workflows/workflows.test.mts reads the go directive of each go.mod with go mod edit -json.
binaries.make: The tests of the recipes (tests/make-install, tests/python-tools) run make -n on the root Makefile.
